title: JetBlue Airways Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: JetBlue Airways filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing a Framework Agreement with SKY Leasing affiliates and UMB Bank for $500 million in debt financing secured by up to 22 A320/A220 family aircraft, with maturity dates from 2033 through 2037 and fixed interest rates expected in the range of 6.00% to 6.75%. The agreement also includes a committed accordion feature for up to $250 million of additional incremental financing.
key_points: JetBlue entered into a Framework Agreement dated April 14, 2026 with SKY Leasing affiliates and UMB Bank.
$500 million in debt financing commitments secured by up to 22 A320 and A220 family aircraft.
Loan maturity dates range from 2033 through 2037.
Interest rates expected to be in the range of 6.00% to 6.75%, fixed rate basis (US Treasuries plus applicable margin).
Loans include cross-default and cross-collateralization provisions among the secured aircraft.
Committed accordion feature allows for up to $250 million additional incremental debt financing on terms to be agreed.
